findings.summary: PR body reads as machine-written (em dash, unnamed build/CI claim, conventional-commit title prefix), violating the AI policy that gets PRs closed

Central claim of the fix is false: definitions() already sorted by name on base, so output was already deterministic; no demonstrated need for the change (only -tall attribution order changes, unmentioned and untested)
New test passes on base, so it does not show the PR changed anything
Dead build() line and stale HashMap comment in the test

why: Finding 2 says the claimed nondeterminism never existed on base and the change has no demonstrated need, which matches the maintainer's no-demonstrated-need, bias-to-status-quo reason in substance. Finding 1 is a separate AI-policy reason.
